ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of TATA DUENDE, the small bearded elderly guardian spirit of the Belize jungle. Reproduce his two defining unusual anatomical traits exactly. [tata-duende-c02,c05,c08,c13]
ANATOMY: ONE dwarfed elderly man, ONE head, TWO eyes, TWO arms, TWO legs. Tall battered brown hat, long coarse gray beard, fully opaque dark woven tunic and knee-length trousers. BOTH open hands have FOUR fingers ONLY: index, middle, ring and little finger forming one row of four thin separated upright digits at the top of a rectangular palm. There is NO thumb anywhere. Both lateral sides of each palm run in a completely SMOOTH STRAIGHT contour from wrist to outermost finger: no lateral protrusion, no thumb mound, no folded thumb, no stump. Each palm is turned toward camera, flat not cupped. All FOUR fingers on each hand and both smooth sides of each palm clearly lit, large and inspectable. [tata-duende-c02,c08,c13]

FEET, NON-NEGOTIABLE: Side elevation of BOTH entire bare feet in the bottom foreground. His body walks LEFT, but BOTH feet point RIGHT. At each ankle a rounded plain HEEL bulges toward the LEFT, leading in his walking direction. The long foot arch and ALL toes extend toward RIGHT, trailing BEHIND him. Feet are rotated exactly 180 degrees relative to his LEFT-facing knees. The leftmost ends of BOTH feet must be smooth rounded heels with ZERO toenails or toe divisions. The rightmost ends of BOTH feet have the toe groups with visible toenails. Two separate shins with feet on two horizontal levels, no overlap, no shoe, no toe hidden by leaves. [tata-duende-c08,c13]

SCALE & CAMERA: Close full body side-on view at root height, small stature confirmed by nearby large buttress roots and broad leaves. Hat, face, both palms and both feet entirely inside frame. Flat side view of feet; no extreme perspective on feet. Dominance from close framing, never giant stature.
LIGHT & WEATHER: ONE narrow warm sunset shaft through dark dense canopy lights face, hands and both bare feet; walnut shadows and copper rim, disturbed ordinary leaf litter. Natural light, no magical mist.
SURFACE: Craggy wrinkled elderly skin, coarse beard, battered hat and heavy woven opaque cloth, wet roots.
SETTING: Dark Belize tropical jungle path. [tata-duende-c02,c05]
MOOD: Stern, uncanny authoritative forest guardian, awe-inspiring, never cute or comic. Respectful protective interpretation.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: TWO visible open palms each with exactly FOUR upright fingers and entirely smooth thumb-free side; BOTH bare feet heels LEFT and toes RIGHT, while knees and body face LEFT. No ordinary five-digit hand, no ordinary forward-facing foot. No text, lettering, logo, border, frame, watermark; no extra heads limbs digits; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design, no nudity, explicit gore, glow aura, neon or energy ribbon.
